subject: design-technology

items.q: Is good design just one idea made straight away?
items.correct: No — it is iterative: research, ideas, prototypes, testing and improvement.
items.misconception: Yes, designers make their first idea immediately.
items.random_wrong: User needs don't matter, only the designer's taste.
items.why: Designing follows a cycle and must meet user needs and a specification.

items.q: Whose needs should a product meet?
items.correct: The user's needs, set out in a design specification.
items.random_wrong: Cost is the only thing that matters.
items.why: Designs are evaluated against user requirements and a clear specification.
